title: Chandelier
body:
Chandeliers are a pretty light source, but they fall if there isn't a solid block above to support them.

![image: Chandelier](media/1457974330008014918.png)

So if you're ever in a cave with a huge ledge or a pit you can't see the bottom of...

![video: Chandelier](media/1457974625890996246.mp4)

A fallen chandelier lights up the area around where it lands.
